name: Evaluation Lab
description: Evaluate real projects, author questions from selected task records, and export shareable results.
whenToUse: Run model benchmarks, create personal evaluation questions from selected task records, or share evaluation results.

list_questions.description: List frozen default and personal questions without starting a model.

prepare_run.description: Prepare an isolated answer workspace for a verified model configuration without starting a model.

list_runs.description: Read local execution states and independently graded results.

export_report.description: Export selected results as standalone HTML without raw chats, source files or local paths.

create_question_draft.description: Create a private draft from task excerpts explicitly selected by the user; do not scan other history or start a model.

calibrate_question.description: Execute local grader code from the trusted draft against original, reference and incomplete controls; return a check ID for user freezing in the main page.
